Clicking 'Recent' switches sidebar to show all conversations sorted by last activity
Recent view shows both channels (with # icon) and DMs (with avatar) with unread badges
Clicking 'All Channels' link in Recent view switches back to Channels view
Clicking 'New Message' opens the search modal
New Message panel: searching a registered user (e.g., 'recruiter') shows results
New Message panel: clicking a found user starts a DM
New Message panel: searching unknown email shows invite options (Email, SMS, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Instagram, Copy Link)
Admin tools are collapsed behind a Settings gear icon in the footer
Clicking Settings gear reveals admin tools grid (Analytics, Retention, Audit Log, Compliance, Shortcuts, AI KARAU, Return to Portal)
Compact footer shows: user avatar + name, theme toggle, settings gear, logout
Sidebar scrollable area is cleaner without old stack of full-width buttons
Dashboard still shows 'Invite to ENZI' tile that opens invite modal
Backend API: GET /api/lumi/invite/link works and returns invite_url, sms_text, linkedin_url
